items.note: States the forward invocation y_S<-y_S+x_S for arbitrary scratch, and (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restored auxiliaries (a plain swap over F_2). It derives this as the paper does: net change (JV+RG)x, central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2 cancelled by side injection, then three stages. The wire counts W_b, W_c are not given, but they are not needed for the lemma.

Gives D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, including on auxiliary roles. It derives this by the paper's invariant: the stored array is the vertex frame applied to the logical array, carried across edges and through gates by linearity.

Covers the form I-J/9 and the F_2 dot product, the terminal labels, interstage compatibility, the central labels A⊗F and B⊗F, side-edge nesting by orthogonality, telescoping to Wm-2N, L=Ich, and L/N=100/539 and 101/539. All follow the paper. The F_2 orthonormal-basis clause of the lemma is only asserted, in S1.3.3.3, not derived.

Has the projections P_U, the source matrix -P_{U_a}, rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the N rank-one exceptions 2P_{U_a}, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, and the endpoint difference I_m on every role. These match the proof at 1156-1171.

Has phase frames C_U, weight additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, the conversion of each odd-weight factor into aI+bX_v, s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c, and repair of the X_a->Y_a route by Z_{a,k} and i^{27k}. It ends with C^{⊗m} on every role and on k columns, following the paper step by step.

Gives L/N<1/2, the deficits N-2L_b and 2N-2L_c, and the exact eta_b and eta_c above 20·2^{-50}. With log m<20 and m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-eta), this yields s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, exactly as at 1331-1343.

Both lemmas are stated with their content: digit permutation and move, split and merge, cyclic row split, and the controlled update y->y+a mod q^b with an offset computable in b^{O(1)} time, plus rational units. Neither has a method or sub-steps.

Gives A=E_1 Pi E_2 by elimination around the rightmost entry of the topmost nonzero row, triangular updates in descending order, and the add/swap/subtract sequence costing one interchange per one of Pi, as in the paper. The prime is described only as avoiding the denominators. The paper also requires q to avoid the numerators of diagonal entries, so the triangular factors stay invertible mod q (1415-1417).

Covers the cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, frames Phi_M giving H<-H+D on every row, and the swap by three updates. Then come s recursive calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum giving O(e^tau), and the depth-first parking schedule. All follow 1491-1588.

Covers the rho high digits joined into a row field of range at least W^k, zero-row padding to a multiple of W^k, the base-m pieces summing to O(Ve^tau), and numerical padding from [2^u] to [q^e] giving O(Vu^tau). This is the paper's proof; the unequal-width remark is not covered.

Has the P_M conjugation putting residual directions on coordinate slots, one child (C^{±1})^{⊗f} per residual vector, and exactly s_c children. Inverse children come via (C^{-1})^{⊗f}=(-i)^f Z C Z, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D. Row additions are done by packed calls, as the paper does.

Covers the eight-operation cycle composition, packed cyclic shifts, guard set B, delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, repair by permuting B and radix sorting, and the normalized extra terms. All follow the proof. The stated time drops the M·A_rect^3 scan term and the A_rect(R+A_rect) factor of the repair term in eq. 2004-2005, though S1.5.4.6 restores them in normalized form.

Covers the node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), q_0 row chunks with range at least W^{k_0}, children of volume V/W, and F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves O(e) below d^{1/2}. Summation needs tau(1+2c)<lambda, and the base-m pieces give O(d^{lambda'}) for lambda'>max{lambda, sigma+(1-sigma)/2}, matching 2393-2445.

States the layer on D<=d chunks with K=floor(d^c) in O(Vd^{lambda'}) and error below sqrt2·2^{-p}. Exact Gaussian-dyadic evaluation uses Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p) guard bits and a single truncation, which keeps the disk because rows have absolute sum one. This is the paper's proof.

Covers character cancellation without two-torsion, bit-reversed storage B_t, the reverse procedure giving F^+B^{-1} via H_0^2=I/2, and rounds as a parallel butterfly plus J_E. The layout L comes from prefix moves and chunk exchanges, with truncation commuting with J_E and the order LBF^-. The cost terms match 3007, 3021 and 3103.

Covers evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, four products by the established multiplier, the separation |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2, the carry in {0,1}, the negacyclic wrap with |H_j|<=r2^{2p}, and O(rp log(rp)) cost. All follow the proof.
Has the retained LB order, P(LBu,LBv)=LB P(u,v), the normalization F^-(f*g)=M F^-f·F^-g, and the error chain to sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p}. The cost is as stated at 3401-3403.

Has the HvdH identity, ||N-I||<1/2 for a Neumann inverse, the left inverse D N^{-1} C, P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA, errors 16p and 4+3p^2/4 below p^2, permutations kept symbolic, and the tensor form with error dp^2 and axis cost O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)).

Covers chirp periodicity for even t_i, the coefficient identity giving QF_t u, RF^+R=F^+ by unit dilation, R commuting with the pointwise product, (u*v)/S^2, and conjugation for RF^+. This matches 3938-3987.

Fixed exponents (tau, sigma, lambda, lambda', c, epsilon, delta, kappa) and sizes (b, p=6b, d, K, T, Tp=Theta(n)) are stated. Primes with eta=1/(4d), T/2<S<T and alpha^4 theta>p are derived via the Rosser-Schoenfeld interval bound, Bernoulli, and trial division, as in the paper. alpha and gamma are not given explicitly.

Has Phi: x->prod x_i^{mu_i} as an isomorphism, the triangular mixed-radix formula, prefix-controlled rotations of the valid interval keeping padding zero, and cost O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)). These follow the paper.

Has Theta: x_d->zeta y with the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T as a bilinear contraction, iota moving no data, and twist cost. The per-twist error 4·2^{-p} appears only later, in S4.6.2.

Lists the six-step algorithm (digit scale 2^{-b-2}, Phi, two source transforms, truncated product, opposite transform scaled by S, scale 2^{2b+4}S, rounding, Phi^{-1}, carries). The source transform has exact counterpart 2^gamma B_0 QF_t A=RF_s, and the two occurrences of S are explained as at 4536.

The error chain E_ring<5TL, the convolution <6TL, the chirp <8TL, E_s=9·2^gamma TL, the product 2E_s+2, the opposite 3E_s+2, and E_w<28·2^gamma T^2 L, with disk margins .701, .501, .26 and 1/16. The final error is 448b2^{-b+gamma}<1/2, followed by the carry invariant and the 2n-bit output. All match the paper.

Gives the seven normalized rows and their powers of p, margins with min g_i=2^{-181}=2kappa, setup and exceptional sorting o(V), absorption of log p powers by p^kappa, and the schoolbook cutoff. This is the paper's accounting.
S0 says only that the n log n optimality conjecture 'fails in this model'. It gives no formulation of the eventual lower bound, nor of the liminf criterion its negation needs.

errors.says: The shear lemma holds for a fixed odd prime q 'avoiding the denominators of its factorization'.
errors.paper: The prime must avoid every denominator in the table and also every numerator of a diagonal entry of an invertible factor, so that the triangular factors remain invertible modulo q.

errors.says: Packed selected-bit addition takes O(V(L^tau+1)) time plus a repair term proportional to the bad fraction.
errors.paper: The time is O(V(L^tau+1)+M A_rect^3+delta_bad M A_rect(R+A_rect)); the record-scan term M A_rect^3 is a separate term not proportional to delta_bad. It is O(V(L^tau+1)) only under the family hypotheses.

chain: The tree reaches the main bound O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) by the paper's route. The fixed exchange network, frames, labels and dimension budget lead to the bit and phase interfaces with s<Wm and the exponent 1-2^{-50}. That feeds the two recursive tape procedures (power-width interchange, simultaneous layer), then synthetic transforms and ring convolution, resampling with chirps and permutation cancellation, the CRT layout, exact recovery and time accounting. It thins only at the leaves: the stream primitives are stated without derivation, the F_2 orthonormal-basis argument is only asserted, m=h^3 is never written explicitly, and the conjecture's negation is only mentioned.

steps.note: Has the fixed linear network on triples of [100] (v=C(100,3), N=v^3) mapping (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and restoring every auxiliary wire, which is a plain swap over F_2. m=h^3 is not written explicitly; S1.3 only speaks of an 'm-dimensional bilinear space'.
A common invertible frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, so the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and each edge pays only for its frame change D_vD_u^{-1}.
Labels are nondegenerate tensor subspaces built from triple indicators, and every edge joins nested labels. The only decreasing edges are the central wires 3->4, each losing P⊗F of dimension h.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested nondegenerate labels, and the N source edges are exceptions of rank one (matrix 2P_{U_a}).
The absolute changes total Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, from telescoping at gates plus twice the loss, and adding N source ranks gives s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L/N=300c/v equals 100/539 or 101/539, below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L_b>0 (and 2N-2L_c>0) and s<Wm.
M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role, from P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I and zero/identity on other roles. With the frames Phi_M, the network therefore applies H<-H+D on every row.
A shear by a rank-a matrix factors as E_1 Pi E_2 and costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V), so one node makes exactly s recursive calls.
Children have volume V/W, giving F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1). From s/W<m^tau, with tau=1-2^{-50} obtained from eta>20·2^{-50} and log m<20, this gives F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: All nine steps of the central saving are reconstructed with their defining content and in their roles: the bank-exchange network, frames, nested labels, rank as dimension change, the budget Wm-2N+2L, L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity, edges as s recursive calls, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The only gap is that m=h^3 is never stated explicitly.
